title: Women's Golf – I Only Golf for the Outfits Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Women's Golf Zip Up Hoodie – I Only Golf for the Outfits
seo.description: A women's golf zip up hoodie: I ONLY GOLF FOR THE OUTFITS beside a retro golfer on the back, plus an embroidered golf ball with a bow on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This women's golf zip up hoodie is for the woman who plays nine holes for the outfit and stays for the snack cart, zipped on over a pleated skirt at the first tee and on the clubhouse patio after.

A retro golfer in cat-eye sunglasses and a wide-brim hat, hands on her hips with a club over her shoulder in a pleated pink and green skirt, a flag and a stray ball at her feet, in pink, sage, cream and dark green with a worn print texture. I ONLY GOLF stands in tall condensed capitals beside her with FOR THE OUTFITS beneath it, the second pair of lines a touch wider than the first: mint and pink on Black and Navy, dark green and raspberry on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small golf ball on a tee with a tiny bow is embroidered on the left chest, and the word FORE is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest golf ball and bow and left-cuff FORE, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the I Only Golf for the Outfits zip hoodie fit?
The I Only Golf for the Outfits women's golf zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this women's golf hoodie warm enough for early tee times?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool tee times, windy fairways and the walk back to the clubhouse well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, I ONLY GOLF and FOR THE OUTFITS in tall letters beside the golfer, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small golf ball on a tee with a tiny bow sits on the left chest with no words, and FORE is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The golf ball and bow on the chest and the FORE cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a golfer, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the player who picks the outfit before the club. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
